beats.care: Carry water on trains, avoid long walks in the afternoon, and wear light cotton. Watch for dizziness or headaches.
beats.what: Santacruz logged 38°C on Tuesday, 4.3°C above normal. Colaba hit 36.4°C. IMD's alert covers Oct 14 and 15.
beats.why: After the monsoon left, clear skies let the sun heat the city while sea moisture keeps it humid.

cards.body: Tuesday's 38°C was the fourth straight day at that level.
cards.caption: Above normal at Santacruz

cards.body: IMD scientist Sushma Nair said highs will stay around 37°C for three to four days, then drop to about 35°C.

cards.q: How are you beating the heat?

opts: Clear skies after the monsoon left, plus humidity
cards.q: Why is Mumbai so hot right after the monsoon?
cards.why: The monsoon withdrew on Oct 3; clear skies and humid air push up both heat and discomfort.

hook: Mumbai has hit 38°C *four days running*. When does it ease?

learn.t: The monsoon left Mumbai on October 3, which is why skies are clear and the sun hits hard now.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.title: Mumbai Weather Update: Santacruz Records 38°C For Fourth Consecutive Day As IMD Forecasts Continued Heat

tldr: Santacruz hit 38°C for a fourth day in a row, and IMD has issued a hot and humid alert for Wednesday and Thursday.
watch: IMD expects highs near 37°C for three to four more days, then around 35°C.
